seaquest.name: Seaquest
seaquest.rules:
Rescue divers and surface (swim to top) for bonus points.
You can move and shoot simultaneously (e.g., Right+Shoot, Up+Shoot).
Oxygen is infinite — you do NOT need to surface for oxygen.
You earn a small reward for each diver you rescue, and a larger reward when you surface to deliver them.
You have a maximum of 50 steps. Exceeding this limit ends the game immediately.

lavacrossing.rules:

unlockpickup.name: UnlockPickup
unlockpickup.rules:
Fewer steps = higher reward. Find the shortest path.
Find the key, unlock the door, and pick up the box in the other room.
You have a maximum of 40 steps. Exceeding this limit ends the game immediately.
You cannot drop the key on the door (no matter whether it is opened or not), and you cannot walk over the key.

battlezone.name: BattleZone
battlezone.rules:
Objective: Destroy enemies.
Enemies can still fire at you even when they are outside your visible screen.
You cannot fire another shot until your current shell either hits an enemy or disappears from the screen.

turmoil.name: Turmoil
turmoil.rules:
There are several types of special enemies and objects, tanks can only be destroyed from behind, ghost ship is indestructible.
Sometimes a flashing orb appears at the far end of a tunnel after an enemy is destroyed. You can move down the tunnel to collect it for bonus points, but if you wait too long, it turns into a fast-moving missile that can destroy you.

No matter where you are, the disc will automatically return to your hand.

berzerk.name: Berzerk
berzerk.rules:
Atari Berzerk — maze robot shootout.
Objective: Clear rooms of robots by shooting them, or flee through exits.
Robots shoot back. Touching walls or robots kills you.
After a delay, Evil Otto — an unkillable bouncing smiley face — appears and chases you.
Shoot in 8 directions. Move quickly between rooms.
Scoring: Points per robot killed, bonus for clearing a room of all robots.
Game over: Shot, touched a wall, or caught by Evil Otto.
